description: This Python source file defines API routes for role adjacency features in a career platform backend. It includes endpoints to suggest adjacent roles and detailed adjacency comparisons, utilizing both an external Node RoleMappingService and local database fallbacks. The code involves database queries, data transformations, and route definitions using FastAPI.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] _required_map_by_role_id(db: Session, role_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a mapping of competencies to required levels for a specific role ID from the database.

methods.name: float _weighted_jaccard(map_a: Dict[str, int], map_b: Dict[str, int])
methods.description: Calculates similarity score between two competency level maps using weighted Jaccard index.

methods.name: AdjacentRolesResponse _local_adjacent_roles( db: Session, role_name: str, limit: int, min_score: float )
methods.description: Computes a list of roles similar to the given role based on local database data, with filtering by score and limit.

methods.name: AdjacencyDetailsResponse _local_adjacency_details( db: Session, current_role: str, target_role: str )
methods.description: Provides detailed adjacency information between two roles, including shared competencies and deltas, based on local DB.

methods.name: AdjacentRolesResponse get_role_adjacency( role: str = Query(..., description="Role name (or numeric ID as a fallback)"), limit: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=50, description="Maximum results to return"), min_score: float = Query(0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0, description="Minimum similarity score threshold"), _: object = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint that returns suggested adjacent roles, attempting to retrieve data from external service first, falling back to local computation.
